notes: A source known only by a title («[1/176] رجال الكشي») with the Kashshi not written as a transmitter: needs_ruling (rule 11)

Two sayings, each with its own isnad (rule 4a): saying 1 is Ali ibn al-Hasan's answer about Abu Khadija's name; saying 2 is the Imam's rebuke, carried by Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim through Abu Khadija
«أبي خديجة» is occurrence 2: the first occurrence is in the question («عن اسم أبي خديجة»)
